result.summary: The page is mostly intact. Aside from intentional horizontal-carousel and bottom-viewport clipping, the only visible defect is duplicated content in the 'Fastest near you' row.

issues.description: The first two cards in the 'Fastest near you' row are identical duplicates: same dish image, same 'Green Bowl Poké' name, same '15-25 min' badge, and same '€0.90 delivery' text.
issues.suggestion: Show distinct restaurants in the row, or deduplicate so the same restaurant does not appear twice with identical imagery and details.
